description: Every nonempty structure \(M\) in a countable first-order language has a countable elementarily equivalent structure \(N\), which models \(\operatorname{Th}(M)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Theories.countable_same_theory.{u, v, u_1} {L : FirstOrder.Language} [Countable L.Symbols]
  (M : Type u_1) [L.Structure M] [Nonempty M] : ∃ N, Countable ↑N ∧ L.ElementarilyEquivalent M ↑N
